notes: DRAFT, and additionally PROVISIONAL. It follows the Government's bill on the 2027 fiscal and customs policy (NU-599-MF-2026), approved on 8 September 2026 and reported passed in first reading on 10 September; not published in Monitorul Oficial as of 9 October 2026, so figures may change before adoption. The June 2026 consultation draft differed; what it alone carried (3% for independent activity, closing new registrations of individual enterprises and peasant farms) was dropped from the bill and removed here on 2026-10-11. Not yet encoded from the bill: the personal and major exemptions to 40,020, HoReCa VAT back to 12%, a 12% VAT band for some agricultural produce, gas at 8% only up to 150 m3 a month from 1 April 2027, parcels, and 18% profit tax for section K. Do not file from it. It is also far from complete: none of the keys the product reads for invoices, payments and payroll is here, so from 1 January 2027 they have no value.

sources.act: Proiectul legii pentru modificarea unor acte normative (politica fiscală și vamală pentru 2027), NU-599-MF-2026, aprobat de Guvern la 8.09.2026
Codul fiscal al Republicii Moldova nr. 1163/1997
CAEM revizia 2.1 - clasificatorul activitatilor din economia Moldovei

tax.profit.standard_rate.note: Art. 15 lit. b) untouched by the bill. Its art. IV would set 18% for 2027 for legal entities in section K (financial and insurance activities), by derogation in Law 1164/1997 art. 24 alin. (38); not encoded.

tax.dividend.rate.note: Bill, art. 90^1 alin. (3^1) lit. b) (and art. 91 alin. (1) lit. c) for non-residents): 8% on dividends from profits generated from 2027 onwards; 6% stays for earlier profits. A profit-vintage rule, not a payment-date rule: the engine must resolve the rate from the year the profit arose.

tax.gospodarie_tarneasca.rate.note: Bill pct. 4 adds peasant farms to art. 15 lit. a), so 12% instead of 7%. No explicit repeal of art. 15 lit. c) was seen: to be checked.

tax.profit.undistributed_eligibility_cei.note: Bill: at most 249 employees and annual turnover or total assets of up to 200 million lei, up from 100 million (Law 318/2025 for 2026). The 249-employee condition is not encoded.

classification.caem.revision.note: Applies from 2027-01-01 per secondary sources, re-coding activity classifications on every entity record. Not found in a primary text: the bill and MF Order 106/2025 refer to CAEM-2.

itpark.single_tax.rate.note: Art. 370 alin. (1) untouched by the bill. Law 415/2023 art. 15 alin. (4) lets residents keep working under the rules in force until 2035 inclusive if the rules change: a grandfathering right, not a fixed rate.

tax.profit.undistributed_deferral_until.note: A deferral, not a zero rate. Bill: new art. 87 alin. (1^2), tax on profit earned in 2027-2029 is paid by the 25th of the month after the month dividends are paid; art. 84 alin. (6) changes 2023-2026 to 2023-2029.
